tools.name: sponsor_check
tools.description: FREE. Is this organisation a licensed UK visa sponsor (Skilled Worker etc.)? Returns rating (A/B) and routes from today's Home Office register — top 3 matches.

tools.name: sponsor_search
tools.description: PRO. All licensed sponsors in a town/city, optionally filtered by route (e.g. Skilled Worker, Health and Care) — lead lists for recruiters and immigration advisers.

tools.name: new_and_removed
tools.description: PRO. Organisations added to or removed from the sponsor register since the previous daily update (removed = possible revocation/surrender).

tools.name: b_rated
tools.description: PRO. Sponsors currently B-rated (downgraded, on an action plan), optionally by town — compliance risk signal.

tools.name: register_stats
tools.description: PRO. Counts of sponsors by route and by town (top 30).
